messages:
Maria: Quick summary from the SR audit just now — a few small but high-impact accessibility nits in the Console dark theme :clipboard:

Akshay: thanks — TL;DR?

Maria: - Focus ring on tertiary/ghost buttons in dark theme is too faint (almost invisible at 2px). VoiceOver users miss it.  
- Some inline icon buttons (copy/expand) only announce "button" with no context. Need descriptive aria-labels.  
- Placeholder/secondary text in the Insights table drops below 3:1 contrast at 14px.  
- Keyboard nav trap observed when opening Model Details flyout: tab sequence loops inside the flyout but there are no skip links back to the main content.

TJ: can you paste the failing CSS/markup? small repro helps.

Maria: repro snippets below — dark theme button styles:

```
.button--ghost {
  border: none;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.06); /* too faint */
  outline: none;
}
```

and copy button markup:

```
<button class="icon-btn copy"> <svg.../> </button>
```

Akshay: yeah the `box-shadow` is effectively invisible on #0b0f14. Suggest: increase to 3px and use rgba with higher alpha or a semi-opaque solid outline.

Akshay: e.g.

```
.button--ghost:focus {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
  outline: none; /* keep outline removed but provide visible focus */
}
```

Aisha: for the copy button we should add an accessible name: `aria-label="Copy model ID"` or `aria-labelledby` when combined with visible text. Avoid relying on `title`.

Maria: agreed. Also noted some buttons are in a compact toolbar — screen reader flows better if we expose role and label: `role="button" aria-label="Copy session link"` on plain elements.

TJ: about the contrast issue — is that global token or one-off? if global we should update token, otherwise adjust the table's secondary text to use token `text-secondary-contrast`.

Maria: looks like it's using `var(--text-muted)` which is lower alpha on the text token. Quick win: bump the token for small text to `#BFC7D1` in dark theme (checked in contrast tool gives 3.1:1 at 14px). I'll file a token PR.

Akshay: keyboard trap — what's the exact flow? modal vs flyout? we have different focus-containment helpers.

Maria: Model Details is a flyout (side panel). When you Tab through there is a footer with an inline dropdown that steals focus and the panel's last focusable element doesn't hand back to the page-level skip link. So with keyboard only you can't reach the main page content unless you use Shift+Tab back around.

Aisha: probably missing the `aria-modal` or skiplink focus management. For flyouts we should: 1) set `inert` on background content 2) ensure a skip link focus target at the main content and 3) trap focus but provide a visible close button first in the tab order.

Maria: I can draft a small checklist in the PR:
- [ ] Increase focus ring visibility for ghost/tertiary buttons in dark theme  
- [ ] Add contextual aria-labels to all icon-only buttons  
- [ ] Bump secondary text contrast token for 14px+ in dark theme  
- [ ] Add skiplink/focus target and ensure flyout focus management  

TJ: let's not forget automated tests — can we add pa11y/axe checks for these patterns in CI? add a quick e2e that opens the flyout and verifies tab order.

Maria: good call. I'll include axe assertions and a small puppeteer script that tabs through the flyout and asserts focus sequence.

Akshay: assign me the CSS bits. I'll open a small PR for focus ring + token suggestion.

Maria: thanks — I'll open the accessibility PR with details and link the audit findings. Posting the audit export here:  https://redwood-internal.s3/acc-audits/2026-03-21-sr-audit.json  :eyes:

access-bot: Automated accessibility scan completed for branch `feature/model-details-a11y` — 4 new violations found. See CI artifacts: https://ci.redwood/acc/3456

Aisha: awesome. If we can knock these out this week we should be good for the next release. small wins, big impact.

TJ: +1. If anyone needs voiceover testing I can loop in a session and record quick clips.

Maria: will do. assigning owners in the PR: Akshay (focus CSS), Aisha (icon labels + flyout focus), TJ (e2e + SR recording), Maria (contrast token + PR notes).

Akshay: starting on it now. ping me if you want pair on the token values.

Maria: thanks all. closing the thread here, will drop PR link once open. :white_check_mark:
